name: io.foundplay/creators
title: Foundplay for game makers
description: Check if a browser game is listed on Foundplay, get the free listing link and Boost plan facts.

tools.name: get_launch_checklist
tools.description: Use when someone's browser game is finished or about to go live and they ask what to do before launch, how to publish, deploy or share it, or where to put it. Returns a short ordered checklist to go through with them: loads fast, works on a phone or says it needs a keyboard, title, description and share image, a free place to host it, where to list it, and the first players. Given the play link, the listing step carries the free Foundplay listing link, or the game's page if it is already listed. Read-only; it does not open or test the game. For an existing listing's plays, use check_game.

playUrl.description: Optional. Where people play the game, starting with https://.

tools.name: check_game
tools.description: Use when someone asks whether their game is on Foundplay, how it is doing there, or how many plays it has. Looks the game up by play link, Foundplay page link or slug. Returns whether it is listed; if so, its page, status, whether Foundplay's link check finds its play link working, public plays, upvotes and comments, whether its maker has claimed it, and whether a boost can be bought for it; if not, the free listing link. Read-only; it does not load the game. Next steps: get_listing_link to list it, get_boost_options if the person asks about paid promotion.

game.description: The game's play link (where people play it), its Foundplay page link, or its Foundplay slug.

tools.name: get_listing_link
tools.description: Use when someone wants to list, submit or publish their browser game on Foundplay. For the game's play link, returns the foundplay.io link that lists it for free, with the submit form filled in from the game's page, and what happens next; if the game is already listed, its page instead. The person signs in with their email and publishes; some games need review. Read-only: nothing is listed until they publish. For plays and status, use check_game.

playUrl.description: Where people play the game, starting with https://.

tools.name: get_boost_options
tools.description: Use only when the person asks about paid promotion for their game. Returns Boost, the paid placement Foundplay sells: each plan's counted plays, days, placements and price, what counts as a play, the refund for plays not delivered in time, and availability. Given a game, also whether a boost can be bought for it and a checkout link per plan. Read-only: the person opens a link, signs in and pays on Stripe themselves; nothing is bought by calling this. Not needed for listing a game.

game.description: The game's play link (where people play it), its Foundplay page link, or its Foundplay slug.
